fields.summary: Autonomous plan run (no owner) for change set 01M78RM, filed after the 2026-11-12 performance report: one 'scripts (4/4) / UNKNOWN STEP' flake marked CI unstable and switched the ~20 min serialized local gate on for every run (~525 run-minutes lost), and the journal kept only the gate's last ~2 KB, cutting off the failing test. Read ci_stability.go (any flake in the window makes CI unstable), ship.go (flakes are recorded as 'job / step' or 'CI run <id>', never a test name), ship_gate.go (output kept in memory, 16 KB tail), run.go (a failed step keeps 2 KB / 20 lines), watchdog_flaky.go and the gate-fix prompts (they tell the fixer to rerun rhiza ship gate). Related accepted bug 01M78FD0 already plans a full gate log (ship-gate-full-log) and ignoring unidentified flakes. One question went to the arbiter, who ruled (local-gate-repeated-named-flakes): serve m4-runs-hold-up; a failure naming no test is infra, recorded apart, shown in health, never unstable, no bug filed; a named test is unstable only after flaking on 2 distinct heads in the ciWindow, with a reason naming it, its count and when it stops applying; each gate run writes its whole output to a log file in the run dir, its path in the response and the journal, the failure output ending with the failing test lines and the path; gate-fix prompts read the log. Planned four leaves: named flakes vs infra in the record, the repeated-flake verdict, infra in health, and the per-run gate log. Because 01M78FD0's nodes are not landed, the leaves are new capabilities and the change set depends on 01M78FD0.
fields.title: Local ship gate switches, autonomous plan
